summary: Cycurion filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 25, 2026 it delivered notice terminating for convenience its April 7, 2025 Equity Purchase Agreement with Yield Point NY LLC, effective one business day after receipt; the company stated the move was not due to any disagreement over operations, policies or practices. Separately, a September 24, 2026 press release projected roughly $843,028 of 2026 revenue from closed public-safety engagements, including City of Chicago go-live support, fire training and CAD administration, with a ten-year projected aggregate value of about $3.43 million CAD. No consideration, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for the overhang tied to the terminated equity facility and any replacement financing.
